source.title: Dioralyte Natural Sachets (GSL) — Summary of Product Characteristics

scope: Synthetic adults only; independently assessed standard outpatient context, acute diarrhoea up to 24 hours, no/mild dehydration, tolerated oral fluids, no concerning findings, known history and no current medicines. Exact UK reference product must be confirmed; no local equivalence, WHO low-osmolarity equivalence or fluid-deficit calculation is asserted.

regimen.instructions: For this exact reference product only: dissolve each sachet in exactly 200 mL drinking water. Do not use another diluent or boil the prepared solution. Prepare fresh; discard after one hour at room temperature or 24 hours refrigerated. No fixed daily frequency, course or fluid-deficit replacement plan is generated. Seek review sooner for worsening symptoms; persistent diarrhoea needs reassessment.
